title: Removing a track’s `src`: stale URL and inconsistent clearing/error behavior

labels.name: interop
labels.description: Implementations are not interoperable with each other

body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

(Written with help from GPT-6 Astra High. This came up in @noamr's AI review of https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/13188, which leaves the status quo as it is for now. Somewhat part of https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10331, but deserving of its own issue.)

For an enabled `<track>` that has successfully loaded one cue:

```js
track.onerror = () => console.log("error", track.readyState);
track.removeAttribute("src");
console.log(track.track.cues.length, track.readyState);
```

| | Chromium 156 | Firefox 157 | WebKit 26.5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Synchronous output | `1, 2` | `0, 2` | `1, 2` |
| Subsequent event | `error, 3` | None observed | `error, 3` |
| Final cue count | 0 | 0 | 0 |

(States 2 and 3 are `LOADED` and `ERROR`.)

The spec requires synchronous cue clearing, but updates [track URL](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#track-url) only when `src` is set—not removed.

That also disagrees with all three engines when starting with a disabled track inside a video:

```js
track.src = "valid.vtt";
track.removeAttribute("src");
track.track.mode = "hidden";
```

All three fire `error` instead of loading `valid.vtt`, whereas the spec retains that URL.

### Related issues

- #9683 covers incorrect uses of the track URL concept, including empty-string handling.
- #2916 covers cue clearing when assigning the same URL again.
- #798 discusses resolving media URLs at loading time rather than attribute-setting time, explicitly including `<track>`.

Those overlap with the underlying model; this issue focuses on `src` removal and its observable consequences. Probably all 4 could be fixed at once, once the dust settles around the ongoing attribute change steps PRs.

### Tests

- [src-clear-cues.html](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/html/semantics/embedded-content/media-elements/track/track-element/src-clear-cues.html) tests synchronous clearing on setting/changing `src`. Firefox passes; Chromium/WebKit fail.
- [track-element-src-change-error.html](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/html/semantics/embedded-content/media-elements/track/track-element/track-element-src-change-error.html) includes removal during loading, but combines scenarios and relies on timers.

Standalone tests for removal **after loading** and **before enabling** appear to be missing. These would separate fixing the stale URL from deciding cue-clearing timing and post-load error behavior.
